caption_en: Availability and physical consistency of short-baseline heading from the original RTKLIB moving-base configuration. (a) Cumulative distributions of absolute heading errors at newly available fixed outputs for the three trials; the inset enlarges 0–20° without renormalizing. (b) New-output times; percentages refer to all paired epochs within each trial. (c) Baseline lengths of all 153 fixed outputs in the nominal-walking evaluation window, including 35 with a logged length residual above 4σ. The dashed line is the installed length of 0.35 m, and the gray band is ±4σ with the configured length standard deviation σ = 0.01 m. (d) Enlargement of the shaded 10–22 s interval in (c). All panels use the saved trial windows; the heading quantity is obtained from the horizontal projection of the lateral baseline and compared with the reference yaw.
caption_zh: 原始RTKLIB动基线配置下，短基线航向的输出可用性与物理一致性。(a) 三种工况中新固定输出的绝对航向误差累积分布，小窗放大0–20°，保持原累积分布分母。(b) 新固定输出的时刻；百分比以各实验窗内的全部配对历元为分母。(c) 常规行走评价窗内全部153个固定输出的基线长度，其中35个日志长度残差超过4σ。虚线为安装长度0.35 m，灰带为配置长度标准差σ=0.01 m所对应的±4σ范围。(d) 放大(c)中的10–22 s着色区间。所有面板均使用保存的实验窗口；航向由横向基线的水平投影换算，并与参考航向比较。
meaning_zh: 新固定输出的覆盖率与输出后的物理一致性是两个问题：本组数据中固定解稀疏，且固定状态仍可能伴随显著长度残差。

technical_notes.conditional_CDF: Each CDF uses native-valid outputs only. Coverage shown separately. No held values or interpolation.
technical_notes.time_convention: Upper panels elapsed from each evaluation start; lower panels use clock-corrected output time minus66s, selected by saved observation time.
technical_notes.mechanism: All35 Q1 length warnings had at least one successful float update with the length pseudo-observation. Fixed postfit logs but does not reject these residuals. No unique physical-cause inference.
technical_notes.zoom_selection: 10–22s displays the saved cluster including maximum length0.7077479565m at16s; preexisting diagnostic case, not a new run.
technical_notes.reference_quantity: Lateral-baseline projected heading compared with commercial fused Euler yaw; under roll/pitch the quantities differ.

title_zh: RTKLIB原配置下短基线航向的输出与物理一致性

visual_review_receipt.assessment: Panel alignment, uncut labels, retained full error scales and clear independent output rows. CDF panels retain all native-valid samples. Main figure has0–20deg inset and10–22s baseline enlargement.
